lss.config.receive_server_lods.tooltip: Download distant terrain from this server. Turn off to stop all LOD downloads.
lss.config.lod_distance.tooltip: How far distant terrain loads, in chunks. 0 uses the server's distance.
lss.config.column_rate_limit.tooltip: Caps how fast LODs download. Lower it if loading distant terrain stutters your game or slows your connection. 0 means unlimited.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip: Start gently after joining, then increase the download rate. Applies to native LSS and DH. Turn off to use the full rate immediately.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip.gover: Starts downloads gently on LSS or DH. Has no effect while adaptive transfer rate is off.
lss.config.xaero_map_bridge.tooltip: Save downloaded distant terrain into Xaero's persistent World Map. After Apply, reconnect to activate. Disabling future writes does not erase existing map data.
lss.config.xaero_map_bridge.tooltip.not_: Save downloaded distant terrain into Xaero's World Map, so the map fills in far beyond your render distance. Has no effect right now: Xaero's World Map is not installed.
lss.config.far_players_enabled.tooltip: See other players far beyond your normal render distance, drawn as simple models in the distant terrain. The server must have far players enabled.
lss.config.far_players_share_self.toolti: Allow other players to see your distant model through this feature. Apply saves and activates this preference. Normal Minecraft tracking is independent.
lss.config.far_players_name_tags.tooltip: Show name tags over far player models, and over players still in normal range once they are past the game's own 64-block tag distance. Drawn by this mod, so other mods' name tag settings do not apply to them.
lss.config.far_players_full_bright.toolt: Draw far players at full brightness so they stand out at night. Off keeps them lit like the distant terrain around them.
lss.config.far_players_render_distance.t: How far away, in blocks, far players are still drawn. 0 follows the server's limit. Also caps this mod's name tags.
lss.status.title: LOD status
lss.settings.reload_failed: Settings unchanged. Reload could not complete; check the game log and try again.
lss.settings.pending_reconnect_notice: Some accepted settings are waiting for reconnect.
lss.settings.privacy_sent: Sharing preference sent; the server does not acknowledge delivery.
lss.settings.privacy_no_channel: Sharing preference not sent: no negotiated server channel.
lss.settings.privacy_pending: Sharing preference not sent yet; retrying on this connection.
lss.settings.conflict_detail: The YAML file changed or could not be read. Your edits are retained. Rebase and save rereads the file and applies only your selected edits to it. Discard keeps the disk file. Nothing has been activated.
lss.settings.failure_detail: The save failed. Your edits are retained even if Sodium shows no changes. Retry without re-entering values, keep the draft for later, or discard it. Live settings are unchanged.
lss.settings.inactive: Settings are inactive. Repair the settings file and restart the client; details are in the game log.
lss.status.conditions: Observed conditions (a queue alone does not prove a bottleneck): %s
lss.status.progress: Progress in this world: %s columns, %s bytes; distance %s/%s chunks
lss.status.rate: Rate gate events in this sample: %s; active manual cap %s columns/s (0 unlimited; adaptive cap may also bind)
lss.status.remote_unknown: Remote limiting cause: unknown; ask an operator for server diagnostics.
lss.status.settings.saved: Last read/saved: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, Xaero %s, sharing %s
lss.status.settings.configured: Accepted by reload: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, Xaero %s, sharing %s
lss.status.settings.effective: Active: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, Xaero %s, sharing %s
lss.settings.adoption_pending: Settings accepted; subsystem activation is still pending. Run the client reload command again to retry.
lss.settings.adoption_failed: Settings accepted, but subsystem activation failed. Check the log and run the client reload command again to retry.
lss.settings.normalized: Normalized %s: requested %s; effective %s. YAML was left unchanged.
lss.status.export_waiting: Waiting for a current-session snapshot; retry after the next tick.
lss.status.export_busy: Diagnostics exporter busy; retry after the current export.
lss.status.export_failed: Diagnostics export failed; check directory permissions and free space.
lss.settings.error_logged: Technical details are recorded in the game log.
lss.config.lod_source.tooltip: Allow DH when native LSS is unavailable. Auto-detects the protocol; older servers may reconnect once. Requires Voxy without the DH client. Reconnect to apply. May overwrite saved or newer LOD terrain.
lss.status.dh.terrain: Terrain: DH approximation at block resolution; observed complete/partial/unknown columns: %s/%s/%s
lss.status.dh.columns: Chunk columns in this dimension session: converted %s, enqueued %s, vanilla skipped %s, failed %s
lss.status.dh.resources: Resources: wire %s, owned %s, peak %s bytes; decode %s, requests %s, Voxy backlog %s
lss.status.dh.limits: Limits: %s chunks; generation %s, sync %s requests/s; bandwidth %s KB/s
lss.status.dh.freshness: Freshness: sync on load %s (%s), live updates %s (%s), received/enqueued %s/%s, last reply age %s ms. Ingest completion and persistence remain unacknowledged.
lss.status.dh.state.between_sessions: waiting for the next DH session
lss.status.dh.cache: Source cache: declined %s, pressure drops %s; readback reused/preserved columns %s/%s
lss.status.dh.reason.native_offer: native offer suppresses fallback, including disabled or incompatible service
lss.status.dh.reason.transfer_retry_disa: automatic retry disabled on a transferred connection
lss.status.dh.reason.legacy_trial_suppre: Recent unsuccessful legacy trial; retry temporarily suppressed
lss.status.dh.reason.family_unconfirmed: legacy family is not yet confirmed
lss.status.dh.reason.local_cache_unavail: local source cache unavailable; network acquisition continues
lss.status.dh.reason.source_stopped: source stopped; inspect the local log
lss.config.xaero_map_bridge.tooltip.nati: Writes native LSS terrain to Xaero's World Map. DH terrain goes to Voxy only; this option has no effect while using DH.
lss.status.dh.reason.client_mod_conflict: Official DH client is installed; remove it to use LSS DH compatibility
lss.status.dh.acquisition: Acquisition: %s; gate wait %s ms (-1: readiness unknown, not a delivery ETA)
